summary: Backend-only testing of IMAP UID-based email sync refactoring. All 9 tests passed, verifying UID tracking, state persistence, dedup protection, and endpoint functionality.

minor.issue: IMAP connection often times out (15s timeout) from test environment
minor.note: This is expected due to container network latency to Gmail IMAP

critical_code_review_comments: IMAP connection cleanup properly handles Gmail hanging on logout() - sets 0.5s timeout then force-closes socket
UID tracking correctly persists in imap_sync_state collection with seeded flag
Unique sparse index on email_replies.email_rfc_message_id verified
Dedup protection works: checks both tickets and email_replies collections before creating
seed_data_creation: Created test user (test-imap-user-*) and session for API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMAP UID sync is working correctly. State in MongoDB: imap_sync_state collection stores last_uid (currently 284) and seeded=true. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_imap_uid_sync.py can be reused for regression testing.

verified_features.uid_based_fetch: fetch_emails_by_uid() correctly returns emails with UID > last_uid and returns max_uid
verified_features.sync_state_persistence: imap_sync_state collection stores/retrieves last_uid, seeded flag, updated_at
verified_features.manual_sync_endpoint: POST /api/email/sync uses UID tracking, returns counts (emails_found, tickets_created, replies_added, skipped_duplicates, last_uid)
verified_features.sync_status_endpoint: GET /api/email/status returns connected status, inbox_count, sync state with last_uid/seeded/last_synced
verified_features.dedup_protection: Emails with existing message_id in tickets or email_replies are skipped
verified_features.unique_index: email_replies.email_rfc_message_id has unique sparse index (verified via MongoDB)
verified_features.health_check: /api/health returns healthy status with database check
